message:
Yesterday quite to my surprise I got an envelope in the mail and it was from T-Netix's attorney's. It was a supplement to my formal complaint that one of the counsel's at the PSC had 3 questions for them to answer.

It asked them how was I informed about the PVP and how did I find out about them increasing my credit limit for each one of my telephone lines.
They did tell the truth about this one. It was the territory manager in Maryland and they gave his name. Each one of my lines were increased to $500, I never requested this.

The PSC reequested the current amounts that I owed on my phone bills. T-Netix stated $69.00 which is not true. They don't seem to be able to answer anything correctly.

It's to bad that they don't post the supplements to T-Netix response to me because it would be very easy for anyone reading it to know that they have been personally discriminated against. I have been treated differently then all of the others that post their comments here.

I suspect that they commission will be doing a final ruling soon.
Will keep everyone posted.
